definitions.gloss: to scrape off; to shave off; to pare away
definitions.explanation: Physically removing material by scraping or shaving

definitions.gloss: to cut away; to whittle down; to reduce
definitions.explanation: Figurative: gradually removing or reducing something

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ (to scrape/shave) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take), emphasizing the complete removal of material. Transitive verb.

TRANSITIVITY: transitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to scrape off paint
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to scrape off the surface
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to cut away expenses
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{削|けず}り{取|と}る: to eat into profits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to scrape/shave — the base verb; doesn't emphasize complete removal
- ⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧: to peel off — removing a layer or coating by peeling rather than scraping
- ⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧: to cut off — removing by cutting rather than scraping
